// @path: src/app/ops/families/RotatePanel.tsx
// Amendment C1 says rotating a leaked code never requires displaying it: the
// operator triggers a rotation and the teacher sees the new code in their own
// interface. So the WORDS "family code" must appear on this button, in ordinary
// copy, while the identifier stays unreachable.
//
// This fixture exists because the banned-identifier match was made
// case-insensitive during the QA corpus pass. It is the proof that the change
// did not turn every honest label into a build failure: whole-word matching
// means the two English words never spell the identifier.
export function RotatePanel({ onRotate }) {
  return (
    <form action={onRotate}>
      <p>The family code goes home on paper. Rotating it here issues a new one; the class teacher sees it in their own class settings.</p>
      <button type="submit">Rotate this family code</button>
    </form>
  );
}
